title: Incolor Intropy SR+

takeaways.text: The dealer says Incolor renamed SS/SS+ to SR/SR+ and that this size-54 frame is an SR+ still marked SS+; he reports the change followed customer remarks about the 'SS' name. Incolor's own sources do not state whether the frames are identical.
The Di2 battery sits in a holder under the bottom bracket reachable without removing the bottom bracket; UDH and direct-mount hangers are both supplied.
Brake hoses pass through dedicated holes in the compression ring so they never touch the round steerer, which is offset rather than straight to make room for them.

Computer mount, expander cap, front-derailleur tab and saddle clamp are 3D-printed titanium; the dealer rates the finish among the best he has seen. A printed white paper of Incolor's test data comes in Chinese only.
The dealer's frameset price was €3,290 in October 2025 with these parts included; Incolor claims 720 g for the SR+ frame.

disclosure: French presenter who says Incolor approached him to sell its frames in Europe; the frame shown is his shop stock.
summary: French dealer's walkaround of a size-54 Speedster SR+ frameset still carrying the earlier SS+ marking (automatic French captions).
